title: fix(components,plugin-detail,plugin-dashboard): withhold a masked column from client search, sort and auto width, and set the flag in RelatedList and ObjectDataTable
body:
Part of #10657
Refs #10657 — PR 1 of 2. PR 2 carries the `ObjectGrid` first-paint row (folded objectui#10706) and the host types from `ListView`, after PR objectui#10278; the card stays open for it.
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`TableColumn.masked` is the one authority. The producers ask `isMaskedFieldType()` (objectui#8686) and stamp the flag; `data-table` obeys it and never re-derives it from a type. This PR adds two producers and three table paths:

| path | owner | before | now |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ctrl+C / Cmd+C, `title` tooltip, CSV export | `RelatedList`, `ObjectDataTable` | raw value (no flag stamped) | withheld (flag stamped) |
| client search | `data-table` | matched the raw value | masked column left out of the predicate |
| sort (header click, header menu, both write paths) | `data-table` | ordered by the raw value; under manual sorting asked the host to | disabled |
| auto width | `data-table` | estimated from the raw value's length | sized from the header only |

### By package

- **`@object-ui/components`** (`data-table.tsx`):
  - One reader, `isMaskedColumnKey`. It reads the columns the producer handed the table on this render, not the `columns` state (which re-seeds one commit later and drops hidden columns). It fails closed: a key that names no column answers masked.
  - The client search filters the searched columns through it.
  - `isColumnSortable` gates the header's cursor, its click and its indicator. `handleSort` and `applySort` refuse a masked key. The header menu offers no sort entries for one. `sortedData` stops applying a client sort whose column became masked after the sort was set.
  - `autoSizedWidths` samples no values for a masked column.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-detail`** (`RelatedList.tsx`): a new `tableColumns` memo stamps `masked` at the one seam into the table. It covers the three column builders (authored object columns, bare field names, the auto-derived walk). It reuses `isMaskedDetailFieldType` from the same package, the narrow-only union over the authored `type` and the object-declared type. When nothing is stamped, the list is handed on by reference.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`** (`ObjectDataTable.tsx`): `enrich` stamps `masked` on declared and derived columns alike, from `isMaskedFieldType()` on the authored type OR the object-declared type. It reads the unfolded types, because `normalizeTableColumnType` drops both masked spellings.
- **Fail closed in both producers**: `objectTypesPending` is true while a definition is expected (there is an object name and a `getObjectSchema`) but none is in hand, in flight or after a failed read. While it holds, every column is stamped.
- **Docs**: the `TableColumn.masked` JSDoc and its zod `describe()` (`@object-ui/types`), the data-table docs' "Masked columns" section, the plugin-grid README (one "Not covered" bullet becomes a covered paragraph), and the plugin-detail and plugin-dashboard READMEs. The docs frontmatter is byte-identical (md5 of the first 6 lines is `b34b2ed3…` before and after).
- **Changesets**: `.changeset/10657-components-masked-client-paths.md`, `-plugin-detail-masked-related-list.md`, `-plugin-dashboard-masked-data-table.md`, `-plugin-grid-masked-client-paths.md` and `-types-masked-doc.md`, all `patch`. Each states that the server's read mask stays the real guard (defence in depth).

No new published prop, and no export change. `components` adds one type import (`TableColumn`) from `@object-ui/types`. `plugin-detail` imports its own `isMaskedDetailFieldType`. `plugin-dashboard` imports `isMaskedFieldType` from `@object-ui/fields`, which it already depends on.

## Decisions, and what they rest on

- **Reachability was measured first, as the triage asked, through the real hosts. The red leg below is that measurement.**
  - `object-data-table` hands `data-table` no `manualSearch` and no `manualSorting`, so its search box and header sort run in the browser. On base, the term `ZULU` kept the row whose password is `RAW-ZULU-10657`, and a click on the API Key header ordered the rows by the raw value.
  - `object-grid` over inline data runs the same client paths, and was red on base for search, sort and width.
  - `RelatedList` turns the table's search off and drives the sort itself (`manualSorting` plus `onSortChange`). So its header click reached the list's own client sort, which ordered by the raw value on base.
  - The width path runs in every host.
- **Sort is DISABLED, not refused on click.** The flag is known at render time, so the honest shape is an inert header, the same shape `sortable: false` and `sortingEnabled` already use: a header that looks sortable and does nothing is a dead affordance. It is disabled in both modes. A manual sort orders by the same credential one layer out; `RelatedList`'s header sort is exactly that path.
- **Width: from the header, not "from the drawn mask" literally.** The table cannot read what the producer's `cell` draws; it is a React node. Restating the six-bullet mask in `components` would give the mask a second owner. The drawn mask does not depend on the value, so the column is sized value-independently, from its header, with the same floor as every column. Whether the floor holds the bullets without clipping was **not measured in a browser**.
- **Fail closed means every column while the types are unknown**, in the two producers this PR touches. The cost is stated in their changesets: in that window no cell copies or shows a tooltip, no header sorts, the dashboard search matches nothing, and widths come from the headers. A host whose data source has no `getObjectSchema` has nothing to wait for, so the authored types decide there.
- **The union in `plugin-dashboard` is two calls to the authority, not an import of `isMaskedGridColumn`.** Importing it would need a new `plugin-grid` export and a new dependency edge, the dispatch's stop condition. No type list is restated.

## Evidence: red, then green

- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/ObjectDataTable.maskedColumn-10657.test.tsx` (13): copy, tooltip, CSV export, search and header sort over declared and derived columns, width, and the fail-closed held and rejected arms.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/maskedColumnClientPaths-10657.test.tsx` (3): the `ObjectGrid` row, with search, sort and width over inline data. Its copy, tooltip and export rows are the existing objectui#10583 pins, which are this row's control.

Commits after them are `d2afe3619` (three `any` annotations dropped in `RelatedList.tsx`, no runtime change), the changesets, the merge, and `3f8fad899` (two READMEs). The pins and type-check were re-run on the final head `3f8fad899`. CI runs the full suites.

The lint row is a narrowing, not the repo-wide `pnpm lint`, which CI owns. It covers exactly the changed files. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and the diff cannot move a verdict in an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not covered, measured by a throwaway probe (deleted), and stated in the docs and changesets.** In both producers' fail-closed window (the definition in flight, or its read rejected), a field the object declares `password` is drawn as its raw text: `RAW-ZULU-10657` was in the table body in all four arms. The flag withholds everything else in that window. This is the folded objectui#10706 class at two more producers. It belongs with this card's PR 2 or a sub-issue of it (dedupe words: `related list first paint password`, `object-data-table schema pending raw`, `fail closed draw withheld column`).
- **Not covered, measured by the same probe.** `RelatedList`'s own opt-in filter box matched `ZULU` against the masked value (the row stayed), and a `type: 'list'` card's sort buttons ordered the rows by it. Both paths are reachable through a `related-list` node that sets `filterable` or `sortable`; the in-repo `record:related_list` sets neither. Proposed as a sub-issue of objectui#10657 (dedupe words: `related list filter masked`, `RelatedList sortedData password`, `related list sort buttons secret`).
- **Out of scope, read at source, not measured.** The data-table header menu offers "Sort ascending / descending" for a column declared `sortable: false`: the menu gates on `sortingEnabled` only, while the header gates on `col.sortable !== false`. The contract is `TableColumn.sortable`: "Whether column is sortable". `Seam: spec:TableColumn.sortable (@object-ui/types) → renderer:data-table header context menu`. This PR gates the menu on the masked flag only, and leaves `sortable: false` alone (dedupe words: `context menu sortable false`, `data-table header menu sort ignores sortable`).
- **The pending objectui#10583 changeset** lists the client search, the sort, the width and the two producers under "Not covered". It publishes verbatim, and `check-changeset-overwrite` forbids editing it, so the objectui#10657 changesets state that those entries no longer hold.
- Overlap:
  - Draft PR objectui#10710 edits `packages/types/src/data-display.ts` in the `DrillDownConfig` region. Its `data-display.ts` hunks (head `a1217b515`) `git apply --check` cleanly on this branch.
  - Draft PR objectui#10278 edits `packages/plugin-grid/README.md` in its pagination paragraph. Its README hunk (head `eab4c8e52`) applies cleanly here too.
  - Both were open when the card was claimed. No other open PR touches a file of this PR; all 9 open PRs' file lists were re-read with pagination, and each count equals the PR's `changed_files`.
- The `plugin-grid` changeset describes the effect `object-grid` users see through `@object-ui/components`. The grid's own source is unchanged in this PR, and `ObjectGrid.tsx` and `ListView.tsx` are untouched.
